metadata.description: Claude Code mods forked from other authors, kept in one repo

plugins.name: md-prompt
plugins.description: Paints Markdown onto the prompt box as you type: syntax-highlighted code blocks, inline code, bold, italic, lists, tables, quotes, links and headings. Paint only, your text is never changed. Fork of nogu66/md-prompt.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Live plan progress bars above the Claude Code prompt, with subagent strips and soft sounds. Fork of zycck/claude-mods: runs on the desktop app's engine, no plan-mode import, no demo-reel file writes.
